variants.name: A-classic-vertical.png
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a production-quality Chinese ARPG equipment hover tooltip DESIGN PROPOSAL, focused on outstanding typography and compact readable information hierarchy. This is a newly generated mockup, not an edit preserving the old layout.
Input image 1 is ONLY the current tooltip's content and amulet icon reference; image 2 is the established game's art/style reference. Keep its modern saturated stylized cartoon fantasy, midnight blue panels, warm restrained gold trim, cyan magical gems, clean softly beveled surfaces. Art should match the chunky painted blue/gold equipment and charming fantasy inventory. Borrow the practiced item-information organization of Diablo-like ARPGs (Path of Exile and Last Epoch), but retain OUR blue/gold visual language.
Render a single polished UI screenshot, not a wireframe, poster or physical device. Straight-on crisp UI with a lightly defocused subdued crop of our inventory behind it. Tooltip is the obvious focal point, fully visible with comfortable margins. No external commentary text, variant labels, game logos or watermarks.
Typography: a graceful readable Chinese display title with subtly calligraphic/serif details; regular-weight clear Chinese sans-serif body; tabular Arabic numbers, excellent kerning, generous line-height, precise alignment. Only title and important numerical changes have emphasis. Body is NOT all bold. Visually distinct tiers of title, primary number, normal affixes, muted metadata. Never repeat affix name on a second line. Thin dividers and whitespace rather than many nested boxes. Only ONE primary attribute, attack 3. Three affixes are secondary. Tier badges tiny subordinate. Quality orange title accent, blue T2 accent, muted T3. Inactive set bonuses muted but legible, active projected change green.
Content must be exactly these Chinese labels and values, reflow to your layout:
Title "雷纹护符"; metadata "传说 · 饰品" and "强化 0/5"; state "未装备".
ONE primary stat "攻击" value "3"; small breakdown "基础 3  +  强化 0".
Affixes one row EACH: "攻击 +6" with "T2"; "生命 +60" with "T3"; "暴击率 +12%" with "T3".
Set heading "狂战士" current count "1/3 件". Inactive bonuses "(2) 攻击力 +15" and "(3) 暴击率 +12% · 暴击伤害 +50%".
Effect heading "特殊效果", sentence "命中向附近敌人传导 30% 伤害".
Comparison heading "装备后"; "角色攻击 21 → 45" and green "+24"; "狂战士 1/3 → 2/3" and green "激活 2 件：攻击力 +15".
Do not invent item levels, stars, sockets, rarity rules, other equipment stats, extra affixes or controls. Do not put a large equip action button in a hover tooltip. At bottom a small unobtrusive hint "按住 Alt 查看详情" is optional conceptual interaction.
Avoid horror, blood, skulls, heavy gothic metal, antique books, beige parchment, excessive ornament, dashboard/SaaS cards, gigantic numeric posters, tiny cramped text, duplicated attribute labels.
DIRECTION A — Classic ARPG typography translated into modern cartoon fantasy. Portrait-oriented composition around 4:5, a SINGLE narrow elegant centered vertical tooltip, approximately 380 px wide by 600 px high at game scale, enlarged enough in this image to inspect type. Strong symmetrical centered header: small floating teal/gold amulet emblem, warm orange title, quiet metadata below. ONE tasteful shallow gold-edged navy header slab, otherwise clean open navy body. Main attack stat centered, medium-sized 3 with label. Affixes as centered short line text with discreet T badges. Set area left-aligned like a readable small chapter with a subtle green left rule, NOT a boxed card. Special effect is a two-line pale gold accent. Compact comparison footer aligned left/right. The overall panel has soft rounded corners and a minimal fine gold double-edge, no heavy historic engraving. Classical ARPG reading rhythm with beautiful Chinese text. Make this distinct from a conventional left-icon/right-heading application card.
